resource_class: read_only; one thread; restricted MAT reader (64 MiB per file); MemAvailable >= 1 GiB before each read; no MATLAB/OpenSim

source_processing_statements.statement: Force-plate tables are declared to be in the OpenSim frame with Y up.
F in N; M divided by 1000 to N m; COP P divided by 1000 to m.
COP uses zero top-cover thickness; plate origin Y is negated "for some reason" (publisher comment).

Only the local Fz/Mx/My used for COP are low-pass filtered (FilterFreq default 15 Hz, filtfilt); local COP is set to the plate origin (0) when local Fz > -10 N or nonfinite; exported F and M are the unfiltered btk global wrenches.
All force, COP and moment triples pass through Vicon.transform(...,"OsimXYZ").
Row-vector rotation: OpenSim (X, Y, Z) = Vicon (X, Z, -Y).
Markers pass through the same OsimXYZ transform; TRC markers remain in mm.
Markers divided by 1000 and compared with plate COP; contact is _vy > 100 N.
Plate _v and _p are applied to calcn_r/calcn_l, both expressed in ground; no torque identifier, so plate moments are not used by inverse dynamics.
ID uses correlateForcePlates side assignment (RampID for ramps) and filters ID output.
ik_offset = ik minus the mean static-trial IK, per coordinate.
Ramp ID assumes the third plate may carry either foot and splits trials at idle midpoints.
fp is ground reaction force of all plates at 1000 Hz; static and ik_offset (angles relative to the static pose) added 4/28/2024; no units or axis statement for fp.

source_processing_caveat: The toolbox converters (C3DtoMOT, C3DtoTRC, transform) are shipped with the data, but no producer log ties them to the published fp/markers files. Their stated frame is corroborated below by the data, not proven as the producer. The btk wrench force-sign convention is not stated in the scripts; force-on-body is supported by the publisher contact rule, the ID load application and the absence of samples below -100 N.

figure_examples.kind: right-stride means (120-600 samples), each stride centred

pelvis_check.method: Marker pelvis frame (x = mean ASIS - mean PSIS, z = R_ASIS - L_ASIS orthogonalized). One constant marker-to-model rotation fitted per recording (orthogonal Procrustes against R = Rz(tilt) Rx(list) Ry(rotation) built from source IK), then decomposed in the same Z-X-Y order. Angle differences are wrapped and median-centred. Heading-removed tilt: R = Ry(h) Rz(theta) Rx(phi), forward tilt = -theta, for both source IK and markers.
pelvis_check.independent_prompt: Verifier (seed 58213) reported the same Z-X-Y reproduction on two treadmill recordings without the constant offset; re-derived here on this sample with the offset, across all four modes.
pelvis_check.interpretation: The source pelvis coordinates are successive Z-X-Y rotations of the model pelvis (reproduced within a few degrees in all modes). Because subjects face lab Z, pelvis_tilt is mostly frontal obliquity, so the adapter pelvis_sagittal_angle = pelvis_tilt is wrong. No source-derived forward tilt is validated at the stride level: on treadmill the heading-removed source tilt is nearly identical to -pelvis_list (sample r about 0.99) and neither reproduces the stride-mean marker tilt (r 0.07 and -0.25); overground stride-mean r is 0.30-0.81 from 8-13 strides of mixed ascent/descent per recording, with stride-mean amplitudes of 2-5 deg. Sample-level agreement is not sufficient. Pelvis and the four inherited segment angles stay source-only/unresolved; the treadmill disagreement is unexplained (marker noise, soft tissue or IK weighting not separated).

grf_vertical_{ipsi,contra}_BW.frame: publisher lab/ground frame: +Y up (model gravity -Y), +X and +Z horizontal, right-handed
grf_vertical_{ipsi,contra}_BW.sign: positive upward support on the body; publisher contact rule is _vy > 100 N and ID applies _v to calcn
grf_vertical_{ipsi,contra}_BW.note: Gravity-aligned on ramps, not surface-normal. Exported force is the unfiltered btk global wrench. BW normalization inherits the unresolved SubjectInfo.Weight unit.

grf_anterior_{ipsi,contra}_BW.source: selected plate _vz times per-cycle pelvis-marker sign along lab Z
grf_anterior_{ipsi,contra}_BW.sign: positive toward the measured walking direction along lab Z
grf_anterior_{ipsi,contra}_BW.missing_when: pelvis markers missing, heading not Z-dominant, or sign changes within the cycle
grf_anterior_{ipsi,contra}_BW.note: Lab Z component only; heading deviation within Z-dominant cycles is reported per recording, not rotated out.

grf_lateral_{ipsi,contra}_BW.source: selected plate _vx, unsigned by heading or leg
grf_lateral_{ipsi,contra}_BW.note: Lab +X is the right foot's outward side when facing -Z, inward when facing +Z, and forward or backward on X-direction plates. Pending D-GT21-C01-1.

cop_anterior_{ipsi,contra}_m.source: (plate _pz - lateral ankle marker z / 1000) times the anterior sign
cop_anterior_{ipsi,contra}_m.origin: lateral ankle marker, not a joint centre
cop_anterior_{ipsi,contra}_m.missing_when: vertical force < 0.2 BW or anterior sign missing
cop_anterior_{ipsi,contra}_m.note: Source COP comes from 15 Hz (default) filtered local Fz/Mx/My and is set to the local plate origin, not NaN, when local Fz > -10 N; the adapter 0.2 BW mask removes those samples.

cop_lateral_{ipsi,contra}_m.note: Same heading/leg ambiguity as grf_lateral. Pending D-GT21-C01-1.

cop_vertical_{ipsi,contra}_m.note: Source _py is the plate surface height in the lab (0 on floor and treadmill, step/ramp heights elsewhere).

plate_moment_xyz.note: Magnitudes of hundreds of N m on contact indicate a moment about a plate or lab point, not a free moment at the COP. Reference point and sign are not stated; publisher ID does not use them.

plate_assignment.treadmill: named Treadmill_R/Treadmill_L plates (publisher TransformForceplates uses heel geometry for all modes)
plate_assignment.overground: unique plate with > 2/3 COP-nearer heel/toe midpoint during > 100 N contact, else missing
plate_assignment.note: Levelground files include a virtual Combined plate (publisher combineForcePlates: vertical-force-weighted COP); not separated from its components.

joint_angles.source: ik_offset (= ik minus mean static IK; publisher RUN_OSIM.m 63-69), degrees
joint_angles.sign: hip_flexion +flexion (about segment +Z); knee_angle +extension (range -120..10 deg), negated to flexion-positive by the adapter; ankle_angle +dorsiflexion about the oblique talocrural axis (about 12 deg from Z)
joint_angles.note: Zero is the static standing pose, not the model zero. Version-1 archives (AB17) lack ik_offset and static. Open question queued after the two current decisions.

joint_moments.source: OpenSim ID generalized forces divided by mass
joint_moments.sign: positive along the coordinate; knee negated by the adapter
joint_moments.note: Publisher ID applied plate force at the COP in ground, no plate torque; filtered after ID.

pelvis_tilt_list_rotation.composition: R_pelvis_in_ground = Rz(pelvis_tilt) Rx(pelvis_list) Ry(pelvis_rotation): model axes (0,0,1), (1,0,0), (0,1,0) applied as successive rotations; reproduced from markers in every sampled mode (see pelvis_check).
pelvis_tilt_list_rotation.note: Subjects walk along lab Z, so pelvis_rotation is near +90 or -90 deg. pelvis_tilt is then a rotation about lab Z (mostly frontal obliquity) and pelvis_list carries forward/backward tilt with a sign that flips with walking direction.

pelvis_and_segment_sagittal_angles.source: adapter: pelvis_sagittal = pelvis_tilt; thigh = pelvis + hip_flexion; shank = thigh - knee flexion; foot = shank + ankle; trunk = pelvis + lumbar_extension
pelvis_and_segment_sagittal_angles.note: pelvis_tilt is mostly obliquity, so the current mapping is wrong and all five segment angles are unsupported. No source-derived forward tilt (heading-removed IK tilt, equivalently -pelvis_list on -Z-facing treadmill) reproduces marker tilt at the stride level on treadmill; overground evidence is partial. Keep source pelvis_tilt/list/rotation under source names only. Pending D-GT21-C01-2.

prior_audits_revalidated.gt21-force-geometry.json: AB06 treadmill: forward -Z, left-to-right +X agrees with this sample; anterior sign matched source_negative on all 228 legs because that recording faces -Z.
prior_audits_revalidated.gt21-measured-force-direction.json: Coordinate statement (anterior signed lab Z, lateral lab +X, vertical +Y, COP origin lateral ankle marker) matches the adapter source. Lateral is a lab axis, not anatomical.
prior_audits_revalidated.gt21-plate-assignment-fix.json: Assignment rule matches gtech_select_force_plate.m; Combined plate handling not covered.
prior_audits_revalidated.gt21-completed-force-readback.json: AB06 only; readback checks decoding and declared lab mapping, not anatomical frames.
